title: Out-of-Sync / Lie Comments
pattern: Descriptive comments whose assertions directly contradict the operations performed in the underlying code.
why_bad: Actively deceives the reader, introducing bugs during maintenance because developers trust the comment instead of carefully auditing the expression.
detection: The literal constants, logic branches, or formulas described in the comment conflict with the syntax tree of the code.
fix: Correct the comment to match the code, or delete the comment entirely.
source: Fowler, *Refactoring*, Chapter 3 ("Bad Smells - Comments"); Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code*, Chapter 4, p. 53.
